name: Qt QJsonDocument
reason: QJsonDocument::fromJson(QByteArray). Metric decision 2026-11-17: Qt cannot qualify regardless of the technical blocker. QJsonDocument lives in QtCore, so the Debian sources qtbase-opensource-src (96,909) and qt6-base (67,857) cover whole multi-library frameworks and their sourcemax counts are format-ambiguous. PROTOCOL.md's fallback then needs a format-specific binary development package with at least 1,000 installations; Qt has none (qt6-base-dev 4,942 is framework-wide and libqt6core6t64 covers all of QtCore). The path was not built further. A local build also failed to link a parser-only target against a pinned QtCore; that blocker is recorded but is not the deciding reason.
